{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABXC4HVw", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6PzhAmY9A", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 57, "title": "Add a licensed Gene Light PMX showcase to public Examples", "body": "## Problem

The public Examples gallery currently demonstrates PMD (the Miku model) for animation and Worker physics, but offers no directly accessible **PMX** example. We want a rights-aware, reasonably lightweight public demonstration of PMX-specific features such as IK, grants, morphs, before/after-physics ordering, and rigid-body modes including type 2.

Use the author-published **CG-CA Gene lightweight PMX** (`Gene_light.pmx`) as the initial candidate. Its upstream [official source](https://github.com/mmdagent-ex/gene) includes lightweight textures under `light/`, a full `Gene_light.pmx`, original README notices, and sample `motion/` VMDs. The repository already supports a **private** pinned download of full `Gene.pmx` via [`scripts/model-sources.json`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/scripts/model-sources.json), but **that private workflow is explicitly excluded from Pages** and must not be exposed or silently repurposed for public distribution.

## Expected outcome

Add a standalone, easily discoverable **"PMX — Gene (Light)"** example in the public Examples browser while retaining all existing PMD, audio, pose, and Worker examples. It should load `Gene_light.pmx` and its matching light textures, demonstrate the **actual features present in the PMX**, and present appropriate credits and terms. Reuse existing MMDLoader / MMDAnimationHelper APIs and presentation conventions; no new physics/IK engine work.

Proposed filenames: `examples/webgl_loader_mmd_pmx_gene.html` and `examples/webgl_loader_mmd_pmx_gene.ts` (names may be adjusted for consistency).

### Pre-merge acceptance criteria — mandatory, all verifiable before merge

- [ ] **Rights and provenance gate before adding public assets:** Review the upstream pinned revision's `README.md`/`README.ja.md`, CC BY 4.0 notice, and additional Gene trademark/design conditions and usage guidelines. Record the exact source revision, asset list and permitted use in the repository. The source says academic/personal noncommercial trademark/design use is permitted and asks for contact regarding other commercial use: do **not** claim unconditional commercial permission. If the proposed publication has an unresolved rights restriction, **do not upload or publicly rehost those files**; document the blocker and resolve it with a permissible approach before considering the public-demo requirement satisfied. No post-merge approval/rights check may be used as a prerequisite that can only be completed after merge.
- [ ] Use an immutable upstream commit and verified manifest (paths, sizes and hashes) for `Gene_light.pmx`, its required files in `light/`, applicable source notices, and only a small, actually suitable selection of author-provided VMDs if needed. Prefer the light assets instead of the ~59 MB full `tex/` set; verify the PMX's *actual texture references*, case-sensitive paths and loadability before deciding which files to ship. Do not include unnecessary archived assets or copy the entire existing private-model catalog into Pages.
- [ ] Preserve correct original attribution and CC BY 4.0 links on the page and in `examples/README.md` / applicable third-party notices. Include the author-requested credit exactly: `CG-CA Gene (c) 2023 by Nagoya Institute of Technology, Moonshot R&D Goal 1 Avatar Symbiotic Society`. Preserve a link to original READMEs/terms, identify any changes, and clearly separate model/texture/VMD rights from this package's MIT license.
- [ ] Create a standalone PMX example loadable directly and through a **"PMX — Gene (Light)"** gallery card with unique hash navigation. Use a properly attributed preview from an authorized source (or a locally generated preview of the permitted scene), rather than an unrelated/uncleared image. Preserve existing desktop/mobile gallery and browser Back/Forward behavior.
- [ ] Render and animate the real PMX with `MMDLoader` and `MMDAnimationHelper` using the existing renderer/outline conventions, preserving working camera/orbit controls and meaningful loading/error status. Exercise IK, grants, morphs and physics in a way that can be observed; expose **usable controls** for supported morph weights or a small selection of demonstrated expressions, IK/physics enable/disable, and rigid-body debugging. If a sample VMD is used, verify that it actually plays with this PMX and its redistribution terms cover inclusion.
- [ ] Inspect the **actual pinned lightweight PMX** with the project's released `mmd-parser` and document feature counts/availability (bone hierarchy, IK chains, grants, pre/post-physics flags, body types 0/1/2, joints, vertex/group/UV/material/bone morphs, SDEF, additional UV, etc.). Never claim SDEF/bone morph/group links are supported by this asset unless detected. Prior full-Gene inspection in `docs/local-models.md` reports 87 bodies, 92 joints, grants, 53 type-2 bodies, but **0 SDEF vertices and no bone morphs**; validate the lightweight PMX independently instead of extrapolating.
- [ ] Integrate the **public** asset acquisition/copying into the existing `examples:assets`, `build:examples`, and Pages deployment packaging as appropriate. Integrity-check all fetched files and notices; fail clearly on missing/changed assets. Keep the private `examples/assets/private/` workflow excluded from public artifacts. Public URLs, compiled Worker/Ammo/Three imports, and textures must work under GitHub Pages' `/three-mmd-loader/` prefix without requiring COOP/COEP.
- [ ] Update the required Pages manifest paths and the relevant examples/build/browser tests. Before merge, run end-to-end browser checks using actual licensed pinned assets where permitted, exercising the PMX page, feature toggles, morph changes, debug mode, absence of runtime errors, and gallery navigation. Keep synthetic fixtures where useful for deterministic isolated behavior; do not assert subjective appearance or performance improvements.
- [ ] Run and report `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run test:browser`, `npm run build`, `npm run build:examples`, and `git diff --check`, with relevant checks of the project-prefixed static build. **All mandatory checks must be executable before merge**; no live-site access, deployment triggered by merge, or maintainer visual inspection is a pre-merge gate.

### Required post-merge verification — tracked separately; never blocks PR merge

Publication by the merge-triggered GitHub Pages workflow can only be confirmed **after** merge. Record this as **PENDING** at PR time, not a passing pre-merge check: verify successful Pages deployment, that the published gallery links to the new PMX page, that all public PMX/texture/notices URLs load, and that the demo starts without errors. Add deployment URL/commit/date and results afterward; if publication fails, report it as a follow-up rather than changing pre-merge acceptance retroactively. This section is intentionally **not a pre-merge checklist**.

**Optional maintainer visual follow-up (not a blocker):** The maintainer may inspect visual quality, hair/clothing physics, IK, grants, and morphs on the published example after merge, and create focused follow-up Issues for any differences. No manual visual sign-off is needed to merge or close this implementation Issue.

## Context

- Official Gene model and terms: https://github.com/mmdagent-ex/gene (especially `README.ja.md`, `README.md`, `Gene_light.pmx`, `light/`, `motion/`).
- Existing private Gene catalog/feature inspection: [`docs/local-models.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/local-models.md) and `scripts/model-sources.json` (full `Gene.pmx`, private only).
- Existing Examples gallery and app: `examples/index.html`, `examples/scene.ts`, `examples/README.md`.
- Build/deploy: `scripts/fetch-example-assets.ts`, `scripts/build-examples.ts`, `scripts/pages-manifest.ts`, `.github/workflows/examples-pages.yml`.
- Related completed implementation Issues: #39 PMX phase/IK/grants; #47 Worker Physics; #53 Type-2 native physics correction; #55 IK constraints.

**Out of scope:** adding Uka in this issue, claiming every PMX feature is present, implementing missing SDEF/bone-morph features, changing public physics defaults, or broad refactoring of the renderer/physics stack.", "url": "https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/57", "created_at": "2026-10-14T03:36:54Z", "state": "OPEN", "repository": "takahirox/three-mmd-loader", "labels": ["task"], "priority": null, "status": "In Progress", "is_archived": false}, "context": {}, "resources": {}, "allocation": {}, "instruction": null, "run_id": "8d7f8a24ff554f4398280ca7613b8442"}
